CAPTIONS.text: Student 001 prepares 60 supervision enquiries for 11 universities.
SHA-256 merges identical source files before parsing.
Recipient, subject, salutation and body evidence identify mail sources.
Repeated name, email and institution columns identify the reference roster.
PDF files enter the attachment pool directly. Uncertain content needs review.
The operator ignores the notes and completes classification.
Recipient addresses normalize to the same email key. Select the complete version.
A same-name, same-institution match needs a separate contact decision.
Check reference identities and existing sent-mail and draft history.
Scroll from the first prepared mail to the last, across all 60.
Try the exact file path, then a unique basename.
Match mail hints: four PDFs fulfil 211 per-mail attachment requirements.
Choose Australia/Sydney, 09:00, weekdays, one per institution per day and a seven-day gap.
The first RMIT enquiry takes Friday 23 October.
The second tries each date. Reject capacity, weekend and interval conflicts.
Friday 30 October passes. A different institution may share the same minute.
Australian holiday dates are skipped in the remaining plan.
Sixty assignments settle into the real schedule matrix, across 15 dates.
Freeze the selected tasks and pass their content, files and schedule through Chrome runtime.
Open compose, fill fields, verify attachments and confirm each draft save.
The offline provider reports 60 saved drafts and 211 verified attachment uploads.
SmartMail Ops. Sixty enquiries, prepared as one batch.
